find_exercise_by_name.description: Turn an exercise name into its record, without guessing. The name is matched exactly first and then as part of a name, and a name that fits several different exercises is refused with the candidates listed rather than resolved to an arbitrary one. Use it to look up something a person named, where picking the wrong movement would be worse than asking again.

description: Look up exercises from a workflow: 1,500 of them, each with an animated GIF, the muscle it targets, the muscles it also works, the body part and the equipment it needs, plus step-by-step instructions. Search by name or by a rough idea, filter by body part, muscle and equipment at once, pull everything for one muscle, draw a random exercise, or build a whole workout spread evenly across the areas you name and the kit you actually have. Every action reads: nothing here changes anything. No account or API key required.
